column1: # Tools this environment expects. Nothing in this repo installs them, because
# several want interactive setup and that decision is the operator's.
# Tab-separated. Columns: tool, need, what it is for, macOS command, Linux command
# {arch} in a Linux command is replaced with this machine's architecture.

column3: cloning this repo, and the plugin managers for tmux and nvim shell out to it
the login shell everything else assumes. Making it the default needs an interactive chsh, so that stays yours
terminal multiplexer. Everything in tmux/ is inert without it
the editor nvim/nvim.symlink targets. Ubuntu ships 0.9, too old for the OSC 52 clipboard, so take the upstream build
draws the shell prompt. Without it zsh falls back to a bare prompt and the tracked starship.toml does nothing
prefix + Tab window switching in tmux, the git coi alias, and Ctrl-P in nvim
backs the Leader-p project search in nvim. Without it that one mapping fails
parses agent session history (lazyagent JSON) for the tmux Tab switcher preview
runtime for coc.nvim and copilot. Without it both stay unloaded and the rest of nvim is unaffected
C compiler for building treesitter parsers. Without it markdown highlighting falls back to the parsers nvim bundles
